note: #2767 item 1 (unescaped nested straight quote inside a double-quoted decision): `findClosingQuoteIndex` never existed under that name anywhere in this repo's git history (verified via `git log --all -S`), so this was measured against today's actual mechanism, `isFollowedByFramingVerb`'s single `indexOf` scan for the same quote character. That scan still stops at the first same-character occurrence -- the nested "camelCase" -- so a genuinely attributed decision ("Alice reports") is still wrongly accepted as this issue's own live resolution; the comment's described gap is present today (MATCH).
title: Adopt camelCase for identifiers
body:
Whether this design reads well is ultimately a matter of maintainer preference.

"Maintainer decision (#100, 2026-09-01): use "camelCase" for identifiers. Keep it consistent," Alice reports.
